title: Instance spec (headless instance builder input)
description: A small DARP instance described as a road graph with travel times, vehicles and requests. Consumed by the headless instance builder of the graph editor (`web/graph-editor/tools/build-instance.ts`), which derives the distance matrix and writes the instance files (`config.yaml`, `requests.csv`, `vehicles.csv`, `dm.csv`, optional `vehicle_data.json`) and a picture of the instance. Node ids must be exactly 0..n-1; the checks that cannot be expressed here (unknown node references, duplicate edges, onboard requests, …) are reported by the builder.

nodes.description: Road network nodes. Ids are the node indices used in the instance files. Positions are optional, but all nodes or none must have them; without positions the graph is laid out automatically.

x.description: Horizontal position in layout units (`settings.layout_unit_px` pixels each, default 256); x grows to the right.

y.description: Vertical position in layout units; y grows downwards.

edges.description: Directed road segments with their travel times. The distance matrix is the all-pairs shortest travel time over these edges.

bidirectional.description: Also add the opposite edge with the same travel time.

vehicles.description: Vehicles; the array index is the vehicle index. For a `fleet-sizing` instance, the vehicles are not an input and go to `vehicle_data.json` instead of `vehicles.csv`.

position.description: Node the vehicle is at, or the source node of the edge it travels along (`en_route_to`).

en_route_to.description: Target node of the edge `position → en_route_to` the vehicle is travelling along. The vehicle state is then written to `vehicle_data.json`.

remaining_time.description: Seconds left to reach `en_route_to`; at most the travel time of the edge.

onboard.description: Requests already picked up by this vehicle (not yet dropped off). The vehicle state is then written to `vehicle_data.json`.

pickup_time.description: Seconds; when absent, the request is assumed to be picked up as late as possible (shortest drive from its origin to the vehicle position).

max_delay_seconds.description: Written as `max_delay` (absolute mode) to `config.yaml`; absent = no maximum delay.

current_time.description: Current time of the instance (seconds) when vehicles carry requests; absent = derived from the onboard requests. Written as the vehicles' `operation_start`.

layout_unit_px.description: Pixels per layout unit of the node positions in the picture.
